Scientist Bob McGwier joins Danny Jones to discuss a claim about people who can call UFOs at will. The episode title quotes the claim: there are ten of them. It also says a DARPA-linked scientist confirmed the group.

McGwier talks about the so-called super users and how they say they draw craft to them. He shares what tests and watches have shown, as he reads them. Jones asks how a mind could call a craft from the sky. Listeners get one of the wildest claims in UFO lore, from a guest with a hard science past. The library holds the talk as an archive record.
